test_name: System and Communications Protection - SC-13 Secondary Control Gap
architecture:
System: Identity-Hub-179
Primary NIST family: System and Communications Protection (SC); evidence focus: SC-13.
Environment: AWS Commercial. Network access uses VPC interface endpoints; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a KMS CMK. Control evidence: one private service endpoint is awaiting the planned restrictive egress policy update, with no public ingress. The gap is documented as a secondary control deficiency; there is no plaintext transport, no public database exposure, no unencrypted administrator credential in S3, and privileged MFA remains enabled.
